name: Influenza (Flu)
explanation: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses that infect the nose, throat, and lungs.
explanation_am: በኢንፍሉዌንዛ ቫይረሶች የሚከሰት ተላላፊ የመተንፈሻ አካላት ህመም፣ አፍንጫን፣ ጉሮሮን እና ሳምባን ይጎዳል።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba qufaa vaayirasii influenzaan dhufu yoo ta'u, funyaan, qoonqoo fi sombaa miidha.
treatment: Rest, fluids, antiviral medications if prescribed. OTC pain relievers for fever and aches.
treatment_am: እረፍት፣ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ፣ ፀረ-ቫይረስ መድሃኒቶች ካስፈለጉ። ለትኩሳት እና ህመም OTC ህመም ማስታገሻዎች።
treatment_om: Boqonnaa fudhachuun bishaan dhuguu. Qoricha antiviral yoo barbaachise fayyadami.

name: Common Cold
explanation: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract, usually caused by rhinoviruses.
explanation_am: በራይኖቫይረሶች የሚከሰት የላይኛው የመተንፈሻ አካላት ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba vaayirasii karaa qufaa ol-aanaa, rhinovirus irraa dhufu.
treatment: Rest, stay hydrated, OTC decongestants and antihistamines for symptom relief.
treatment_am: እረፍት፣ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ፣ OTC ዲኮንጀስታንቶች እና አንቲሂስታሚኖች ለምልክቶች ማስታገሻ።
treatment_om: Boqonnaa fudhachuun bishaan dhuguu. Qoricha OTC fayyadami.

name: COVID-19
explanation: A respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, ranging from mild to severe.
explanation_am: በ SARS-CoV-2 ቫይረስ የሚከሰት የመተንፈሻ አካላት ህመም፣ ከቀላል እስከ ከባድ ሊሆን ይችላል።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba sombaa vaayirasii SARS-CoV-2 irraa dhufu, salphaa hanga hamaa ta'uu danda'a.
treatment: Isolate, rest, fluids. Seek medical care if breathing difficulty occurs.
treatment_am: ይነጠሉ፣ ያርፉ፣ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ። የትንፋሽ ችግር ካለ ሕክምና ይፈልጉ።
treatment_om: Adda of baasi, boqonnaa fudhachuun bishaan dhuguu. Rakkoo hafuura yoo qabaatte gara dokitaara deemi.

name: Pneumonia
explanation: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid.
explanation_am: በአንድ ወይም በሁለቱም ሳምባዎች ውስጥ ያሉ የአየር ከረጢቶችን የሚያቃጥል ኢንፌክሽን።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba sombaa keessatti qilleensa guutu kan bishaan guutuu danda'u.
treatment: Antibiotics (bacterial), antiviral or antifungal medications. Hospitalization may be required.
treatment_am: አንቲባዮቲኮች (ባክቴሪያ)፣ ፀረ-ቫይረስ ወይም ፀረ-ፈንገስ መድሃኒቶች። ሆስፒታል መተኛት ሊያስፈልግ ይችላል።
treatment_om: Antibiotics (baakteeriyaa), qoricha antiviral. Hospitaala seenuu barbaachisuu danda'a.

name: Bronchitis
explanation: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes that carry air to and from the lungs.
explanation_am: ወደ ሳምባ አየር የሚያጓጉዙ የብሮንካይ ቱቦዎች እብጠት።
explanation_om: Qilleensa gara sombaa geessu kan bronchial tubes dhiita'uu.
treatment: Rest, fluids, humidifier. Antibiotics only if bacterial. Cough suppressants may help.
treatment_am: እረፍት፣ ፈሳሽ፣ ሂዩሚዲፋየር። አንቲባዮቲኮች ባክቴሪያ ከሆነ ብቻ። የሳል ማስታገሻዎች ሊረዱ ይችላሉ።
treatment_om: Boqonnaa, bishaan, humidifier. Antibiotics yoo baakteeriyaa ta'e qofa.

name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)
explanation: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, typically caused by a viral or bacterial infection.
explanation_am: በቫይረስ ወይም ባክቴሪያ ኢንፌክሽን የሚከሰት የሆድ እና አንጀት እብጠት።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba garaa fi minjaala vaayirasii ykn baakteeriyaan dhufu.
treatment: Stay hydrated with clear fluids. BRAT diet. Seek care if symptoms persist over 3 days.
treatment_am: ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ። BRAT አመጋገብ። ምልክቶቹ ከ3 ቀን በላይ ከቀጠሉ ሕክምና ይፈልጉ።
treatment_om: Bishaan dhuguu. BRAT diet. Yoo mallattoon guyyaa 3 ol itti fufe gara dokitaara deemi.

name: Migraine
explanation: A neurological condition causing intense, debilitating headaches often with nausea and light sensitivity.
explanation_am: ብዙ ጊዜ ማቅለሽለሽ እና ለብርሃን ስሜታዊነት ጋር የሚከሰት ከባድ ራስ ምታት የሚያስከትል የነርቭ ሁኔታ።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba narvii kan mataa cimaatti dhukkubsiisu, yeroo baay'ee darara fi ifaaf miira qabu waliin.
treatment: Rest in a dark quiet room. OTC pain relievers, triptans if prescribed. Identify and avoid triggers.
treatment_am: በጨለማ ጸጥ ባለ ክፍል ያርፉ። OTC ህመም ማስታገሻዎች። ምክንያቶቹን ይለዩ እና ያስወግዱ።
treatment_om: Bakka dukkana fi nagaa ta'e boqonnaa fudhachuun qoricha dhukkuu fayyadami.

name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
explanation: A condition where blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated, increasing risk of heart disease.
explanation_am: በደም ቧንቧዎች ውስጥ ያለው የደም ግፊት ቀጣይነት ባለው ሁኔታ ከፍ ያለ ሲሆን የልብ ህመም አደጋን ይጨምራል።
explanation_om: Dhiibbaan dhiigaa yeroo hunda ol'aanaa ta'uu kan dhukkuba onnee dabaluu danda'u.
treatment: Lifestyle changes: low-sodium diet, exercise, no smoking. Medication as prescribed.
treatment_am: የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ለውጦች፡ ዝቅተኛ ጨው አመጋገብ፣ ልምምድ፣ ማጨስ ማቆም። መድሃኒቶች እንደታዘዙ።
treatment_om: Jijjiirama jireenya: nyaata xiyyoo gadi, shaakala, sigaaraa dhiisi. Qoricha dokitaaraan kenname fayyadami.

name: Type 2 Diabetes
explanation: A chronic condition affecting how the body processes blood sugar (glucose).
explanation_am: ሰውነት የደም ስኳርን (ግሉኮስ) እንዴት እንደሚያስተናግድ የሚጎዳ ሥር የሰደደ ሁኔታ።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba yeroo dheeraa kan qaama sukkaara dhiigaa (glucose) itti fayyadamu irratti dhiibbaa qabu.
treatment: Diet control, exercise, blood sugar monitoring. Oral medications or insulin as prescribed.
treatment_am: አመጋገብ ቁጥጥር፣ ልምምድ፣ የደም ስኳር ክትትል። የአፍ መድሃኒቶች ወይም ኢንሱሊን እንደታዘዙ።
treatment_om: Nyaata to'achuun shaakala. Sukkaara dhiigaa hordofuu. Qoricha afaaniin ykn insulin fayyadami.

name: Anemia
explanation: A condition where you lack enough healthy red blood cells to carry adequate oxygen to body tissues.
explanation_am: ለሰውነት ቲሹዎች በቂ ኦክሲጅን ለማጓጓዝ በቂ ጤናማ ቀይ የደም ሴሎች የሌሉበት ሁኔታ።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba qaama keessatti hujjifni dhiigaa gahaa ta'e oksijinii geessuu hin dandeenye.
treatment: Iron supplements, vitamin B12, dietary changes. Treat underlying cause.
treatment_am: የብረት ተጨማሪዎች፣ ቪታሚን B12፣ የአመጋገብ ለውጦች። መሰረታዊ ምክንያቱን ያክሙ።
treatment_om: Suppleemantii biroo, vitamin B12, jijjiirama nyaataa. Sababa jalqabaa yaaluun.

name: Appendicitis
explanation: Inflammation of the appendix causing severe abdominal pain, requiring immediate medical attention.
explanation_am: ከባድ የሆድ ህመም የሚያስከትል የአፔንዲክስ እብጠት፣ ወዲያውኑ ሕክምና ያስፈልጋል።
explanation_om: Appendix dhiita'uu kan dhukkuba garaa hamaa fidu, hatattamaan gara dokitaara deemuu barbaachisa.
treatment: Emergency surgery (appendectomy) is typically required. Do not delay seeking care.
treatment_am: አስቸኳይ ቀዶ ጥገና (አፔንዴክቶሚ) ብዙ ጊዜ ያስፈልጋል። ሕክምና መፈለግ አይዘገዩ።
treatment_om: Qophii hatattamaa (appendectomy) barbaachisaa dha. Gara hospitaala hatattamaan deemi.

name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
explanation: An infection in any part of the urinary system — kidneys, bladder, ureters, and urethra.
explanation_am: በሽንት ስርዓቱ ማንኛውም ክፍል ውስጥ ኢንፌክሽን — ኩላሊቶች፣ ፊኛ፣ ዩሪተሮች እና ዩሪትራ።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba karaa fincaanii keessatti — kalee, bladder, ureter fi urethra.
treatment: Antibiotics as prescribed. Drink plenty of water. Cranberry juice may help prevent recurrence.
treatment_am: አንቲባዮቲኮች እንደታዘዙ። ብዙ ውሃ ይጠጡ። ክራንቤሪ ጭማቂ ድጋሚ መከሰትን ሊከላከል ይችላል።
treatment_om: Antibiotics dokitaaraan kenname fayyadami. Bishaan baay'ee dhuguu.

name: Allergic Rhinitis (Hay Fever)
explanation: An allergic response causing cold-like symptoms triggered by allergens like pollen, dust, or pet dander.
explanation_am: እንደ ዱቄት፣ አቧራ ወይም የቤት እንስሳ ቆዳ ቅንጣቶች ባሉ አለርጂዎች የሚቀሰቀስ አለርጂ ምላሽ።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba allergii kan mallattoo qufaa fakkaatu fidu, pollen, dhoqqee ykn bineensa manaa irraa dhufu.
treatment: Antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids, avoid triggers. Allergy shots for long-term relief.
treatment_am: አንቲሂስታሚኖች፣ የአፍንጫ ኮርቲኮስቴሮይዶች፣ ምክንያቶቹን ያስወግዱ። ለረጅም ጊዜ እፎይታ የአለርጂ መርፌዎች።
treatment_om: Antihistamines, corticosteroids funyaanii. Sababa allergii irraa of eegi.

name: Asthma
explanation: A condition where airways narrow and swell, producing extra mucus and making breathing difficult.
explanation_am: የአየር ቱቦዎች የሚጠቡ እና የሚያብጡ ሁኔታ፣ ተጨማሪ ሙከስ ያመርታሉ እና መተንፈስን ያስቸግራሉ።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba karaa hafuuraa dhiphatu fi dhiita'u, mucus dabaluu fi hafuura dhiphisuu.
treatment: Inhalers (bronchodilators, corticosteroids). Avoid triggers. Follow asthma action plan.
treatment_am: ኢንሃለሮች (ብሮንኮዲሌተሮች፣ ኮርቲኮስቴሮይዶች)። ምክንያቶቹን ያስወግዱ። የአስም እቅድ ይከተሉ።
treatment_om: Inhaler (bronchodilators, corticosteroids) fayyadami. Sababa irraa of eegi.

name: Depression
explanation: A mood disorder causing persistent feelings of sadness and loss of interest affecting daily life.
explanation_am: ቀጣይነት ያለው ሀዘን እና ፍላጎት ማጣት ስሜት የሚያስከትል የስሜት መዛባት።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba sammuu kan gaddaa fi fedhii dhabuu yeroo dheeraa fidu.
treatment: Therapy (CBT), antidepressants if prescribed, exercise, social support.
treatment_am: ቴራፒ (CBT)፣ ፀረ-ድብርት መድሃኒቶች ካስፈለጉ፣ ልምምድ፣ ማህበራዊ ድጋፍ።
treatment_om: Therapy (CBT), qoricha antidepressant yoo barbaachise, shaakala, deeggarsa hawaasaa.

name: Malaria
explanation: A life-threatening disease caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted through infected mosquito bites.
explanation_am: በተበከሉ ትንኞች ንክሻ የሚተላለፉ የፕላዝሞዲየም ጥገኛ ተሕዋስያን የሚያስከትሉ አደገኛ ህመም።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba hamaa kan parazaayitii Plasmodium jaldeessa dhukkubsataa irraa dhufu.
treatment: Antimalarial medications (artemisinin-based). Seek immediate medical care. Use mosquito nets.
treatment_am: ፀረ-ወባ መድሃኒቶች (አርቴሚሲኒን ተኮር)። ወዲያውኑ ሕክምና ይፈልጉ። የትንኝ መረቦችን ይጠቀሙ።
treatment_om: Qoricha busaa (artemisinin-based) fayyadami. Hatattamaan gara dokitaara deemi. Neetii jaldeessaa fayyadami.

name: Typhoid Fever
explanation: A bacterial infection caused by Salmonella typhi, spread through contaminated food and water.
explanation_am: በሳልሞኔላ ታይፊ ባክቴሪያ የሚከሰት ኢንፌክሽን፣ በተበከለ ምግብ እና ውሃ ይተላለፋል።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba baakteeriyaa Salmonella typhi irraa dhufu, nyaata fi bishaan faalameen darbuu.
treatment: Antibiotics (ciprofloxacin or azithromycin). Rest, fluids, and hospitalization if severe.
treatment_am: አንቲባዮቲኮች (ሲፕሮፍሎክሳሲን ወይም አዚትሮሚሲን)። እረፍት፣ ፈሳሽ፣ ከባድ ከሆነ ሆስፒታል።
treatment_om: Antibiotics (ciprofloxacin ykn azithromycin). Boqonnaa, bishaan, yoo hamaa ta'e hospitaala.

name: Tuberculosis (TB)
explanation: A serious bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs.
explanation_am: በዋናነት ሳምባን የሚጎዳ በማይኮባክቴሪየም ቱበርኩሎሲስ የሚከሰት ከባድ ባክቴሪያ ኢንፌክሽን።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba baakteeriyaa hamaa Mycobacterium tuberculosis irraa dhufu, sombaa irratti dhiibbaa qabu.
treatment: 6-month antibiotic course (DOTS therapy). Isolation during infectious period. Regular follow-up.
treatment_am: የ6 ወር አንቲባዮቲክ ኮርስ (DOTS ቴራፒ)። በተላላፊ ወቅት መነጠል። መደበኛ ክትትል።
treatment_om: Antibiotics ji'a 6 (DOTS therapy). Yeroo dhukkubni darbuu danda'u adda of baasi. Hordoffii yeroo yeroon.

name: Coronary Heart Disease
explanation: A disease where plaque builds up in the coronary arteries, reducing blood flow to the heart.
explanation_am: በኮሮናሪ ደም ቧንቧዎች ውስጥ ፕላክ የሚከማች ሲሆን ወደ ልብ የሚሄደውን የደም ፍሰት ይቀንሳል።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba arteries coronary keessatti plaque kuufamee dhiiga gara onnee geessuu hir'isu.
treatment: Lifestyle changes, medications (statins, aspirin), angioplasty or bypass surgery if needed.
treatment_am: የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ለውጦች፣ መድሃኒቶች (ስታቲኖች፣ አስፒሪን)፣ አንጂዮፕላስቲ ወይም ባይፓስ ቀዶ ጥገና ካስፈለጉ።
treatment_om: Jijjiirama jireenya, qoricha (statins, aspirin), angioplasty ykn bypass surgery yoo barbaachise.

name: Chronic Kidney Disease
explanation: A long-term condition where the kidneys don't work as well as they should, leading to waste buildup.
explanation_am: ኩላሊቶቹ እንደሚገባቸው ሳይሰሩ የሚቆዩበት ረጅም ጊዜ ሁኔታ፣ ቆሻሻ ክምችት ያስከትላል።
explanation_om: Dhukkuba yeroo dheeraa kaleen sirriitti hojjechuu dhabu, qulqullina dhiigaa hir'isu.
treatment: Blood pressure control, diet changes (low protein, low salt), dialysis or transplant if advanced.
treatment_am: የደም ግፊት ቁጥጥር፣ የአመጋገብ ለውጦች (ዝቅተኛ ፕሮቲን፣ ዝቅተኛ ጨው)፣ ዲያሊሲስ ወይም ንቅለ ተከላ ካስፈለጉ።
treatment_om: Dhiibbaa dhiigaa to'achuun nyaata jijjiiri (protein fi xiyyoo gadi). Dialysis ykn transplant yoo hamaa ta'e.
